script_text: Gemini, your words could open a door or start a fire this week, so choose carefully before Mercury misfires. Early week, Mercury in your 7th House squares Saturn in your 10th House, pressuring career deadlines. Wednesday, Venus trines your 1st House, boosting love charm and money negotiations. Thursday, the Moon conjuncts Jupiter in your 3rd House, turning chatter into bold opportunity for your twin mind. Late week, Mars in your 6th House sextiles Mercury, fueling weekend work energy and routines. Saturday, Mercury opposes Uranus in your 12th House, risking hidden love anxiety, so pause before texting. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your 1st House and lifts your Air energy. Saturday is your worst day because Mercury opposes Uranus in your 12th House, clouding judgment. Write ideas before speaking daily this week, letting Mercury guide money and love decisions. Follow for daily updates.
